#Importer ACP.f

```{r}
dt_meteo <- read.csv("data/meteo_lm")
```


```{r}
chrono_exp <- function(data, var, exp_sel = NULL) {

  if (!inherits(data$DATE_s, "Date")) {
    data$DATE_s <- as.Date(data$DATE_s)
  }

  if (!is.null(exp_sel)) {
    data <- dplyr::filter(data, exp %in% exp_sel)
  }

  ggplot(data, aes(x = DATE_s, y = .data[[var]], color = exp, group = exp)) +
    geom_line() +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(x = "Date", y = var) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
    scale_x_date(
      date_labels = "%d-%b",
      limits = as.Date(c("2000-08-15", "2001-08-15"))
    )
}

```

```{r}
plot_fdobj_exp <- function(fdobj, exp){
  
  saison <- c("AUTOMNE", "HIVER", "MONTAISON", "FLORAISON", "P300-P1000")
  
  fd_subset <- fdobj[exp]
  
  n <- length(exp)
  
  cols <- rainbow(n)
  
  plot(fd_subset,
       col = cols, 
       lty = 1, 
       xlab = "", 
       ylab = "Moyenne des températures",
       main = "Courbes fonctionnelles estimées")
  
  colours <- adjustcolor(
  c("#E69F00", "#56B4E9", "#009E73", "#F0E442", "#F15854"),
  alpha.f = 0.25)
  
  rect(ref_lm_v[-length(ref_lm_v)],  # xleft
       ylim[1],                # ybottom
       ref_lm_v[-1],               # xright
       ylim[2],                # ytop
       col = colours,
       border = NA)
  
  y_text <- ylim[1] + 0.05 * diff(ylim)
  
  x_centers <- (ref_lm_v[-length(ref_lm_v)] + ref_lm_v[-1]) / 2  # centre des rectangles
  y_label <- ylim[1] - 0.1 * diff(ylim)                         # un peu en dessous
  text(x = x_centers[1:length(saison)], 
       y = y_label, 
       labels = saison, 
       cex = 0.9, 
       xpd = TRUE)

}

plot_fdobj_exp(fdobj, c("INRA13", "INRA18")) 

```
